name: Alternating Lat Pulldown
steps: Sit at a cable machine beneath high pulleys with a single handle in each hand and your thighs locked snugly under the pad.
Sit tall with a slight natural lean back and let both arms extend overhead.
Pull one handle smoothly down beside your shoulder by driving that elbow toward your ribs while keeping the other arm extended.
Guide that handle slowly back overhead and pull the opposite side, alternating arms on each repetition.
tips: Keep your torso level and avoid leaning sideways toward the pulling arm.
Depress your working shoulder blade as you start each pull rather than shrugging.
